why_lead: DJT combines +118.55% twenty-session return, current sharp reversal, actual heavy-volume/halts coverage and retail-broker election contracts; election still pending.

why_smaller.title: Super Micro / SMCI — cheap shares meet expensive doubt
why_smaller.selection_evidence: The dip-buying temptation is obvious: an AI supplier now looks dramatically cheaper on the screen. SMCI closed at USD 29.11, down -37.03% over five sessions and -29.94% over 20 sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-10-31). But Reuters reported EY's resignation as auditor, and Bloomberg specified concerns about integrity.[[n3210]][[n3208]] The emotional bargain pitch is that AI demand has not disappeared just because an auditor has left. The investment problem is that confidence in the numbers determines what investors can sensibly pay for that demand. A lower quotation does not resolve that problem.

why_smaller.title: Reddit / RDDT — the conversation becomes a profitable business
why_smaller.selection_evidence: Reddit's attraction is a business milestone that can travel far beyond an analyst spreadsheet. The Guardian reported its first profit as a public company, and Bloomberg.com highlighted a strong holiday-quarter signal.[[n3201]][[n3196]] RDDT closed at USD 119.30, up +51.78% over five sessions and +76.82% over 20 sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-10-31). A familiar consumer platform becoming profitable gives investors a story they can repeat in a sentence. That familiarity helps explain its appeal; using Reddit and owning its equity remain separate decisions.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: the conversation becomes a profitable business

why_smaller.title: MicroStrategy / MSTR — raise capital and buy more bitcoin
why_smaller.selection_evidence: Forbes reported a USD 42 billion bitcoin investment plan, giving MicroStrategy a fresh, easily repeated ambition.[[n0909]] The appeal is reflexive: enthusiasm for bitcoin can improve access to capital, which may expand the company's bitcoin exposure and generate another round of enthusiasm. MSTR closed at USD 244.50, up +49.62% over 20 sessions, while bitcoin's prior completed daily close was USD 70,215.19, up +12.44% over 20 sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-10-31; Yahoo Finance, prior completed daily close 2024-10-31). The equity is an expression of a financing strategy as well as the underlying asset.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: raise capital and buy more bitcoin

considered_not_chosen: ROOT: strongest direct Stocktwits retail sentiment but no own-card price anchor; retain candidate only.
RDDT: earnings and strong own-card move, selected smaller; platform popularity is not investor sentiment.
CVNA: strong earnings and card move but less direct attention evidence than DJT.
chronology_comparison: Initial edition; no earlier November retail selection.
